description: A crash mid-article leaves no partial rows and the run reports failed (the-actual-news#111). The per-article transaction rolls back, so no story, version, claim, edge, or success capture survives; the run row carries status failed with completed_at null and failed_at set. The error capture (namespaced ingest-error: hash, no blob) is the only capture row.
live_proof: services/ingestion/src/__tests__/identity.test.ts — 'a crash mid-article leaves no partial rows and the run reports failed'. That test throws on the first claims INSERT against the real pipeline; this fixture encodes the post-fix state it produces and the runner below verifies the invariants hold on that state.
note_on_finalize: finalize_ok is true here, not false: finalizeRun checks only success captures, and a crashed run has none, so it finalizes vacuously true (see finalize.ts). The run's own status — failed — is what carries the failure; the finalize receipt is not a second verdict on it.
